author: Praxis III
title: MPB‑GraphFWPCA (power γ): p=1.5, mean‑target 0.04, δ=0.10, kd=20, k=48
abstract: Introduce a power-schedule γ_j = min(γ_max, λ·R²_j^p) with p=1.5 and λ chosen by mean‑target (0.04) to shrink high‑R² PCs more aggressively while preserving moderate PCs. Graph path is MPB‑GraphFWPCA (α_g=0.5, PCA50) + DAQB (δ=0.10, kd=20, k=48). Embedding remains EtC.
